literal_meaning: গোল (ঘূর্ণন বা জটিলতা) লাগা (সংযুক্ত হওয়া বা ঘটে যাওয়া)
example_sentences_in_english: There has been a dispute between the two parties all along.
Suddenly, a quarrel broke out in the meeting.
note: The idiom 'গোল লাগা' derives from 'গোল' implying entanglement or commotion, commonly used in Bengali to describe arising conflicts.
